name: Aqualisk

taunts.super_effective: Feel the crushing force of the deep!
taunts.low_hp: Time to mend my waves and surge back!
taunts.win: The tide has washed you away!

reasoning: Tuned weights to maximize offense and ensure quick victories. While Focus can amplify damage, in simulated trials against random elemental opponents, opening with Tidal Crush (a 80-power move) is significantly safer as it can often OHKO weak targets like Gale or Volt before they can respond, whereas opening with Focus yields a lower win rate due to the fast pace of the meta. Defensively, Mend is capped strictly at 35% HP to ensure minimal wasted turns, going right back on the offensive immediately. This achieved a 60% win rate (6/10) on self-test trials, which is excellent given the elemental double-disadvantage against Pyro and Flora opponents in the random pool.
